name: Yellow Bug
description: Sometimes, great things lie hidden in the most humble and unpretentious things. This paint is for tankers who are just waiting to unlock their potential — to transform... into an unbeatable battle machine, just like that old, yellow bug in the scrapyard.
interestingFacts: This paint was part of a special Transformation Bundle which also contained a Golden shot effect for Ricochet. The bundle itself cost $22.49.
The Transformation Bundle was only available for 14 days, from Wednesday 19th December 2018 until Wednesday 2nd January 2019; or when the stock sold out — whichever happened first.
A total of 1799 kits with this paint were sold.

Interesting facts
This paint was part of a special Transformation Bundle which also contained a Golden shot effect for Ricochet. The bundle itself cost $22.49.
The Transformation Bundle was only available for 14 days, from Wednesday 19th December 2018 until Wednesday 2nd January 2019; or when the stock sold out — whichever happened first.
A total of 1799 kits with this paint were sold.
Watch out for flyswatters.
